# Alex on the Map

> > Travel guides and outdoor recreation resources focusing on America's national parks, hiking trails, and wilderness adventures.

Alex on the Map provides comprehensive hiking guides, trail recommendations, and travel planning resources for national park visitors. The site specializes in detailed coverage of Yellowstone National Park, Glacier National Park, and Acadia National Park, offering both practical packing advice and curated trail selections for outdoor enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Glacier National Park
- Yellowstone National Park
- Grand Prismatic Spring
- Mount Washburn
- Acadia National Park
- hiking trails
- outdoor recreation
- national park planning
- waterfall hikes
- geyser basins
- trail recommendations
- wilderness backpacking
- conservation policy
- tribal rights and cultural practices

## Yellowstone National Park Guides

- [10 of the Absolute Best Hikes in Yellowstone National Park](https://alexonthemap.com/web-stories/10-of-the-absolute-best-hikes-in-yellowstone-national-park): Guide to top 10 hikes in Yellowstone including Grand Prismatic & Washburn

## Glacier National Park Guides

- [8 Amazing Hikes in Glacier National Park](https://alexonthemap.com/web-stories/8-amazing-hikes-in-glacier-national-park): Best hiking trails in Glacier National Park for all skill levels
- [8 Items You Need on Your Glacier National Park Trip](https://alexonthemap.com/web-stories/8-items-you-need-on-your-glacier-national-park-trip): Essential packing list for Glacier National Park Montana trip

## National Park News & Conservation

- [Acadia National Park Looks to Reverse Ban on Sweetgrass Harvesting](https://alexonthemap.com/web-stories/acadia-national-park-looks-to-reverse-ban-on-sweetgrass-harvesting): News on Acadia reversing sweetgrass harvesting ban for Native tribes
